Privacy Policy

Effective 1 November 2026 (2026-11-01)

The short version

  • Winkaboo reads the camera on your phone. Nothing the camera sees is uploaded.
  • Your photos stay on your phone, in Winkaboo. They go to Photos, or anywhere else, only when you save or share them.
  • The AI that reads the picture runs on your phone too. The App Store version of Winkaboo sends nothing to any AI provider.
  • No accounts, no ads, no tracking, and we never sell data.

1. Who we are

Winkaboo is made by CyberFruit Lab - FZCO, a free zone company in Dubai, United Arab Emirates (“we”, “us”). We are responsible for the personal data described in this policy. Questions about privacy: hi@cyberfruit.ai.

Requests about your data: write to hi@cyberfruit.ai; we answer free of charge. Personal data is processed in the United Arab Emirates, where we work, and by Google, GitHub and Cloudflare in the United States and other countries (see “Legal basis, how long, where, and your rights” below).

Our contact for privacy matters (encarregado under Brazil’s LGPD; privacy officer under Korea’s PIPA): hi@cyberfruit.ai.

2. The camera

Winkaboo needs the camera. It looks at the live picture on your phone to find the person in frame, read the pose and the framing, and check faces for things like open eyes, which way they face and sharpness, so it knows the right moment. This analysis happens on the device. Winkaboo does not upload or log what the camera sees. Of the live picture it keeps only your shots: for each, the best frame, its backups and a short silent clip of the moment, on your phone (see “Your photos on your phone” below). You can turn camera access off at any time in Settings › Winkaboo.

3. AI on your phone

Winkaboo uses machine learning, a kind of AI, to read the picture: to find the person, read the pose, the framing and the scene, judge each frame’s sharpness and whether eyes are open, and keep the best frame of each shot. All of it runs on your iPhone, through Apple’s Vision and Core ML frameworks. Besides Apple’s own models, Winkaboo uses two open models, Depth Anything V2 Small (depth) and DETR ResNet-50 (the scene), both under the Apache License 2.0 and credited in the app under Settings › How Winkaboo works.

The App Store version of Winkaboo sends nothing to any AI provider or to any server of ours: no photo, no video, no frame of the camera. Because nothing you shoot reaches us, none of it can be used to train anyone’s models.

4. Your photos on your phone

  • Each time Winkaboo takes a shot, it keeps the best frame and up to two backups in Winkaboo’s own storage on your phone, along with a short clip of the seconds before the catch.
  • With each shot Winkaboo also keeps a few technical measurements — sharpness, open eyes, and a compact numeric fingerprint of the picture and of the people in it — used only to keep the best frame and skip near-copies. This is not face recognition: it never identifies anyone, stays on your phone and is deleted with the shot.
  • Best frames stay until you delete them. Backups are kept for 30 days, unless you saved them to Photos. The short clip is kept for 30 days.
  • Reels are made on your phone from a shoot’s good photos and the short clip of its best one, and are kept with the shoot.
  • Winkaboo’s copies are stored only on your phone and are not part of device backups, so deleting the app deletes them. You can delete shots inside Winkaboo at any time, and their reel follows: it is made again without them, or goes once its shoot has fewer than three shots. That removes them from the app, not from Photos.

5. Saving to Photos and sharing

Winkaboo saves a photo or video to your Photos library only when you ask it to. It asks for “add only” access, which lets it add to your library but not look through it. If you share a shot or a reel with the share sheet, it goes where you send it, and that app’s own privacy policy applies from then on.

6. Reminders

Before the free trial of Winkaboo Unlimited starts, Winkaboo offers a reminder that comes in time to cancel. If you tap “Remind me on …”, iOS asks whether Winkaboo may send you notifications, if it has not asked already. The reminder is a local notification: it is created and shown on your phone, and nothing about it is sent to us. You can turn it off any time in Settings › Notifications › Winkaboo.

7. Purchases

Subscriptions are handled entirely by Apple, through the App Store. Winkaboo asks Apple, on your phone, whether your subscription is active. We never see your payment details or your Apple Account.

8. What we don’t do

  • No accounts: you don’t sign up or give us your name or email to use Winkaboo.
  • No ads, and no advertising or analytics software from other companies in the app.
  • No tracking you across other apps or websites.
  • We never sell your data.

Apple may share with us crash reports and app usage statistics from people who chose to share them with app developers in their iPhone’s settings; they don’t include your name or contact details.

9. Emails you send us

If you write to hi@cyberfruit.ai, including from the Support page or from “Send feedback” in Winkaboo’s Settings (which only opens a new message in your own mail app, or shows our address to copy), we receive your email address and what you write. We keep it only to answer you, and we don’t use it for anything else or share it. Ask us to delete it any time.

10. This website

This site has no cookies, trackers, analytics, or fonts and scripts from other sites. It is hosted on GitHub Pages and Cloudflare, and each may log visits, such as your IP address, under its own privacy statement: GitHub’s and Cloudflare’s.

11. Legal basis, how long, where, and your rights

Why we may use it. We use what you send us to answer you: because you asked us to (steps at your request, and our contract with you when it is about your subscription), and in our legitimate interest in supporting the people who use Winkaboo. GitHub and Cloudflare log visits to deliver this site and keep it secure, in our legitimate interest in running it safely.

How long. We keep an email conversation for up to two years after your last message, then delete it, unless we need it to establish or defend a legal claim. The hosts keep their logs for the periods in their statements.

Where. Our email is hosted by Google (Google Workspace), and this site by GitHub and Cloudflare. They process data in the United States and elsewhere; we work from the United Arab Emirates. For transfers from the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom and Switzerland, we rely on these providers’ certification under the EU–US Data Privacy Framework, its UK Extension and the Swiss–US Data Privacy Framework, or on the European Commission’s standard contractual clauses and their UK and Swiss equivalents. Write to us for a copy of these safeguards.

Your rights. If you are in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom or Switzerland, you have the right to access your data, to correct or delete it, to receive a copy of it and to restrict its use. You can also complain to a data protection supervisory authority, in particular where you live or work. Wherever you live, write to hi@cyberfruit.ai and we will answer within one month, free of charge.

Your right to object. Where we rely on our legitimate interests, you can object at any time, on grounds relating to your particular situation, by writing to hi@cyberfruit.ai.

12. Your choices and rights

You can delete your photos in the app, turn off camera and Photos access in Settings, and cancel your subscription with Apple. Depending on where you live, you may also have legal rights over your personal data, such as access and deletion; email us and we’ll help.

13. Children

Winkaboo is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them. If you believe a child has sent us something, email us and we will delete it.

14. Changes

If we change this policy, we will update the effective date above. If a change affects what we collect, we will say so in the app or on this site.

15. Contact
